changes.to: Categories to filter results by. Pass either an array of category names, such as `["research", "pdf"]`, or an array of objects, such as `[{"type": "research"}]`; one array cannot mix the two forms. `developer` and `gov` must be the only entry in the array, and combining either with another category returns `400`. `research` restricts web results to academic and research websites and returns them in `data.web`; to search paper records, use `GET /search/research/papers`. lang.description: Language code of the page, such as `en`. Absent when unknown.

updatedAt.description: When the page was crawled into the index, in Unix milliseconds. Omitted for results that were never crawled into the index.
